body: Meet The Offroad Artisan, a modern masterpiece built for those who demand both adventure and sophistication. Designed on a Sprinter 170 AWD chassis, this custom van blends sleek aesthetics with unmatched functionality. From its dark green cabinets and wicker accents to its luxurious tiled shower, every inch of this van exudes craftsmanship and style. Whether you’re tackling rugged trails or setting up camp in the remote wilderness, this van’s 500W solar system and 800Ah lithium-ion battery keep you powered up for any journey.

Step inside, and you’ll immediately notice the harmonious blend of modern design and high-end amenities. The refined green cabinetry, paired with rattan accents and premium insulation, creates a cozy yet elegant atmosphere. The tiled shower—complete with Tauleto Bianco tiles—adds a spa-like touch, while the indoor and outdoor shower options provide flexibility for both convenience and outdoor exploration. With a 12V roof-mounted A/C unit and Espar diesel-powered heater, you’ll be comfortable no matter the weather.

In the kitchen, functionality meets style with an Acacia butcher block countertop that features a pop-up extension for extra prep space. The double-burner induction cooktop, stainless steel sink, and Isotherm Cruise 130 refrigerator make meal prep a breeze, while the Zuvo water purification unit ensures you have clean water wherever you go. A seamless lighting system with recessed, dimmable LED ceiling lights adds to the van’s modern appeal, allowing you to create the perfect ambiance for any moment.

When it comes to off-road capability, The Offroad Artisan is second to none. Equipped with an Agile Off Road Lift Kit, all-terrain tires, and a CA Tuned front bumper with D-rings, this van is built to handle the roughest terrains. The Warn 12s winch and Owl Vans bike carrier make sure you’re ready for anything, from rocky mountain trails to sandy desert roads. Plus, the Starlink in-motion kit guarantees that you’ll stay connected, even in the most remote locations.

Designed for long-term adventure and comfort, The Offroad Artisan includes a memory foam queen bed, ample storage, and two FVCO pull-out trays in the garage. With thoughtful touches like magnetic blackout window coverings and a 24-inch smart TV, this van provides a luxurious retreat after a day of exploring. It’s more than just a van—it’s a mobile sanctuary, ready to take you wherever the road leads.
